note: 又名 No Name(对话进行到一半时游戏里的名字会变),靠超长对话把玩家熬走的搞笑 NPC,共 209 句。贯穿全程的梗:贿赂玩家的硬币、两个冷笑话、假魔术、被“想”成牛又被想成羊、模拟论(和陨落之星教团那条线呼应)、以及最后的「蛋糕是个谎言」(致敬《传送门》)和两轮倒数。翻译要保持前后呼应,尤其是蛋糕和模拟这两条线。

messages.raw: §fWhat are you doing in my room?
messages.text: What are you doing in my room?
Get out of my room now!

messages.raw: §fI am going to call the guards if you don't leave
messages.text: I am going to call the guards if you don't leave
messages.zh: 你再不走我就叫卫兵了

messages.text: Guards! Take them into custody NOW!
messages.zh: 卫兵! 马上把这人给我抓起来!

messages.raw: §fWell hmph, I guess the guards are kind of busy right now...
messages.text: Well hmph, I guess the guards are kind of busy right now...
messages.zh: 哼,好吧,看来卫兵这会儿都挺忙的……

messages.raw: §fCan you just leave my room now?
messages.text: Can you just leave my room now?

messages.raw: §fI mean seriously, what is your problem?
messages.text: I mean seriously, what is your problem?
messages.zh: 我说真的,你到底有什么毛病?

messages.raw: §fI have never seen someone that stubborn before.
messages.text: I have never seen someone that stubborn before.
messages.zh: 我从没见过这么犟的人。

messages.raw: §fOk how about this, I'll give you §e1,000 §fcoins if you leave right now?
messages.text: Ok how about this, I'll give you 1,000 coins if you leave right now?

segments.text: Ok how about this, I'll give you
segments.zh: 好吧,这样如何:你现在就走,我给你

segments.text: coins if you leave right now?

messages.text: No? Ok ok how about 10,000 coins then?

messages.raw: §fFor god's sake, please just leave my room!
messages.text: For god's sake, please just leave my room!
messages.zh: 我的老天爷,你就行行好出去吧!

messages.raw: §fAlright alright, how does §61 Million §fcoins sound to you?
messages.text: Alright alright, how does 1 Million coins sound to you?
I guess you wanna stay poor?
messages.zh: 看来你是打定主意要一直穷下去了?

messages.raw: §fYou sure you don't want the coins?
messages.text: You sure you don't want the coins?
Are you suuuuure?
Suuuuuure???

messages.raw: §fWelp I was kidding about the coins anyway...
messages.text: Welp I was kidding about the coins anyway...
messages.zh: 行吧,反正硬币那事我本来就是开玩笑的……

messages.raw: §fNot going to give someone like you coins.
messages.text: Not going to give someone like you coins.
messages.zh: 才不会给你这种人硬币呢。

messages.text: Way too precious.
So how's life? Good?
messages.zh: 那么,最近过得怎么样?还不错?

messages.raw: §fThat's great to hear, how's the family?
messages.text: That's great to hear, how's the family?
messages.zh: 那真是太好了,家里人还好吗?

messages.raw: §fWonderful, so what brings you here actually?
messages.text: Wonderful, so what brings you here actually?
messages.zh: 很好很好,话说回来,你到底是来干嘛的?

messages.text: What makes you play this game?
messages.zh: 是什么让你玩起了这个游戏?

messages.raw: §fWhat makes you continue to click me over and over again?
messages.text: What makes you continue to click me over and over again?
messages.zh: 又是什么让你一遍又一遍地点我?

messages.raw: §fYou know this is gonna go on forever, right?
messages.text: You know this is gonna go on forever, right?
messages.zh: 你知道这会没完没了下去的吧?

messages.raw: §fI won't stop until you go away.
messages.text: I won't stop until you go away.

messages.raw: §fSo now that's out of the way, wanna hear a joke?
messages.text: So now that's out of the way, wanna hear a joke?
messages.zh: 行吧,这话说完了,想听个笑话吗?

messages.text: You do?
Great, get ready!

messages.raw: §fWhat kind of music did the gold nugget listen to?
messages.text: What kind of music did the gold nugget listen to?
*Heavy metal*
I know, very funny!
Wanna hear another one?
I know you do.
Why don't mining towns have hospitals?
messages.zh: 为什么矿业小镇都不设医院?

messages.raw: §fBecause everyone there only ever suffers from ''miner'' injuries!
messages.text: Because everyone there only ever suffers from ''miner'' injuries!
messages.zh: 因为那儿的人受的伤全是「矿伤」——说白了就是「轻伤」!

messages.text: Enough jokes for now...

messages.raw: §fI am surprised you haven't left after those horrible jokes.
messages.text: I am surprised you haven't left after those horrible jokes.
messages.zh: 讲了这么烂的笑话你居然还没走,真让我意外。

messages.raw: §fHave you seen the monster behind you?
messages.text: Have you seen the monster behind you?
messages.zh: 你看见你背后那只怪物了吗?

messages.raw: §fYea over there, just outside of the door!
messages.text: Yea over there, just outside of the door!

messages.raw: §fGo get it, it might want something from you.
messages.text: Go get it, it might want something from you.
messages.zh: 快去抓啊,说不定它有什么东西要给你呢。

messages.raw: §fI think it's the Golden Goblin, it gives out free powder.
messages.text: I think it's the Golden Goblin, it gives out free powder.
messages.zh: 我觉得那是黄金哥布林,它会白送粉末的。

messages.text: Get it before you'll regret it.
messages.zh: 趁早去抓,不然你会后悔的。

messages.raw: §fCome on! Get it, you are gonna miss it!
messages.text: Come on! Get it, you are gonna miss it!
messages.zh: 快去啊! 去抓它,再不去就没了!

messages.text: ... You missed it...

messages.raw: §fWelp I guess no free powder for you then.
messages.text: Welp I guess no free powder for you then.
messages.zh: 行吧,那你就没有白送的粉末了。

messages.raw: §fI have never seen someone stay this long in here.
messages.text: I have never seen someone stay this long in here.
messages.zh: 我从没见过谁在这儿待这么久。

messages.text: You are a special being.
messages.zh: 你可真是个特别的生物。

messages.text: You might deserve something nice!
messages.zh: 你说不定该得点好东西!

messages.text: But not from me.

messages.raw: §fAnyway, do you want to see a magic trick?
messages.text: Anyway, do you want to see a magic trick?
messages.zh: 话说回来,你想看个魔术吗?

messages.text: You do??
Ok get ready!

messages.raw: §fYou need to turn around for this one.
messages.text: You need to turn around for this one.
messages.zh: 这个魔术你得转过身去才行。

messages.text: Promise me?
Good, turn around now!
Tadaa
Are you impressed?
No?
That makes me sad...

messages.raw: §fI guess I'll have to give up my magic career now. Again.
messages.text: I guess I'll have to give up my magic career now. Again.
messages.zh: 看来我这魔术生涯又得放弃了。又一次。

messages.raw: §fI had a lot of hopes and dreams.
messages.text: I had a lot of hopes and dreams.
messages.zh: 我曾经有过很多希望和梦想。

messages.text: I wanted to become a magician.

messages.raw: §fPerform on stage for thousands of people!
messages.text: Perform on stage for thousands of people!
messages.zh: 在舞台上给成千上万的人表演!

messages.raw: §fBut I guess that's not gonna work anymore...
messages.text: But I guess that's not gonna work anymore...
messages.zh: 可我看这事儿是没指望了……

messages.raw: §fBecause of you and those meddling kids...
messages.text: Because of you and those meddling kids...
messages.zh: 都怪你,还有那群多管闲事的小鬼……

messages.text: I mean you. Just you...
You ruined my dream.
I will never forgive you.

messages.raw: §fAnyway, wanna grab a coffee some day?
messages.text: Anyway, wanna grab a coffee some day?
messages.zh: 算了,哪天要不要一起去喝杯咖啡?

messages.raw: §fI like mine with a lot of milk.
messages.text: I like mine with a lot of milk.
messages.zh: 我喜欢多加好多牛奶的那种。

messages.raw: §fI don't know why I like milk so much.
messages.text: I don't know why I like milk so much.
messages.zh: 我也不知道自己为什么这么喜欢牛奶。

messages.raw: §fMaybe I was a cow in my past life?
messages.text: Maybe I was a cow in my past life?

messages.raw: §fImagine I was a cow, how funny would that be?
messages.text: Imagine I was a cow, how funny would that be?
messages.zh: 想象一下我是头牛,那得多好笑啊?

messages.text: Can you imagine that?
Can you?
Try imagining it harder
Try harder!

messages.raw: §fWelp now you imagined it a bit too much...
messages.text: Welp now you imagined it a bit too much...
messages.zh: 行吧,你这下想得有点太用力了……

messages.text: I am a cow now!
How does that even work??

messages.raw: §fHow can someone just turn into a cow just from someone imagining it?
messages.text: How can someone just turn into a cow just from someone imagining it?
messages.zh: 怎么会有人光靠别人想一想,就真的变成一头牛?

messages.raw: §fMaybe I am not a cow, but instead just a hallucination and you are dreaming it all?
messages.text: Maybe I am not a cow, but instead just a hallucination and you are dreaming it all?
messages.zh: 又或者我根本不是牛,只是个幻觉,而这一切都是你在做梦?

messages.text: Have you ever thought about that?
messages.zh: 你有没有想过这种可能?

messages.text: What if nothing was real?
messages.zh: 万一什么都不是真的呢?

messages.raw: §fWhat if everything you knew and loved wasn't real?
messages.text: What if everything you knew and loved wasn't real?
messages.zh: 万一你所熟知、所珍爱的一切,全都不是真的呢?

messages.raw: §fI mean that would be pretty crazy wouldn't it be?
messages.text: I mean that would be pretty crazy wouldn't it be?
messages.zh: 我是说,那可就太离谱了,对吧?

messages.raw: §fWhat if you are just inside of a simulation?
messages.text: What if you are just inside of a simulation?
messages.zh: 万一你其实就活在一个模拟里呢?

messages.raw: §fAnd some higher power would control everything about you...
messages.text: And some higher power would control everything about you...
messages.zh: 而某种更高的存在操控着关于你的一切……

messages.raw: §fHow you look, how you talk, even the core fundamentals of who you actually are...
messages.text: How you look, how you talk, even the core fundamentals of who you actually are...
messages.zh: 你长什么样、你怎么说话,甚至你究竟是个什么样的人,统统都由它决定……

messages.text: I couldn't believe that.

messages.raw: §fI don't think that actually happens with any of us, right?
messages.text: I don't think that actually happens with any of us, right?
messages.zh: 我觉得这种事不会发生在我们身上,对吧?

messages.raw: §fI am still a cow somehow, can you stop imagining me as a cow now?
messages.text: I am still a cow somehow, can you stop imagining me as a cow now?
messages.zh: 我怎么还是头牛啊,你能别再把我想成牛了吗?

messages.text: WHAT?
I am a SHEEP now???
That's not what I meant!!

messages.raw: §fI mean technically I said I didn't wanna be a cow anymore and you kind of did what I asked of you...
messages.text: I mean technically I said I didn't wanna be a cow anymore and you kind of did what I asked of you...
messages.zh: 好吧严格来说,我确实说了不想再当牛,你也算是照我说的做了……

messages.raw: §fBut I didn't think you would turn me into another animal?!
messages.text: But I didn't think you would turn me into another animal?!
messages.zh: 可我没想到你会把我变成另一种动物啊?!

messages.raw: §fWhatever, I think I like being a sheep anyway.
messages.text: Whatever, I think I like being a sheep anyway.
messages.zh: 算了,反正当只羊我好像还挺喜欢的。

messages.text: My wool is so fluffy!
I feel very comfortable here.
messages.zh: 我在这儿待着可舒服了。

messages.raw: §fMaybe that's better than becoming a magician?
messages.text: Maybe that's better than becoming a magician?
messages.zh: 说不定这比当魔术师还好?

messages.text: Becoming a sheep!
I mean that's the life.

messages.raw: §fYou just roam around all day and eat grass.
messages.text: You just roam around all day and eat grass.

messages.raw: §fIsn't that the dream of all humans?
messages.text: Isn't that the dream of all humans?
messages.zh: 这难道不是全人类的梦想吗?

messages.raw: §fTo one day stand in a field and eat grass?
messages.text: To one day stand in a field and eat grass?
messages.zh: 有朝一日站在田野里吃草?

messages.raw: §fNo? I guess that's just me then...
messages.text: No? I guess that's just me then...
messages.zh: 不是?那看来只有我这么想了……

messages.raw: §fBy the way, the reward I told you about earlier?
messages.text: By the way, the reward I told you about earlier?
messages.zh: 对了,我之前跟你提过的那个奖励?

messages.raw: §fThe one that you would get from me?
messages.text: The one that you would get from me?
messages.zh: 就是你能从我这儿拿到的那个?

messages.raw: §fThere is none. There is no cake.
messages.text: There is none. There is no cake.
What, did I just say cake?
messages.zh: 什么,我刚才说「蛋糕」了吗?

messages.text: I meant there is nothing.
The cake is a lie.
Don't worry about it.
There will be no cake whatsoever!
This is a no cake zone.

messages.raw: §fIt says it on the sign right over there.
messages.text: It says it on the sign right over there.
messages.zh: 那边的牌子上就是这么写的。

messages.raw: §f"No cake zone" It says it right there!
messages.text: "No cake zone" It says it right there!
messages.zh: “无蛋糕区”,那儿写得清清楚楚!

messages.raw: §fSee? So it's clear now, there is no cake.
messages.text: See? So it's clear now, there is no cake.
messages.zh: 看到没?这下清楚了吧,没有蛋糕。

messages.text: Glad we got that over with.
Because there is no reward.
None.
Anyway, what's your name?
messages.zh: 话说回来,你叫什么名字?

messages.text: %s? That's an awful name
I have seen better names.
messages.zh: 我见过好听得多的名字。

messages.text: Way better names.
That one you have - not good.
Just wanted to make that clear.
Anyway, my name you ask?
messages.zh: 话说回来,你问我叫什么?

messages.text: I don't have a name.

messages.raw: §fI need one more ingredient to make The Cake for the next person I can get to listen to me.
messages.text: I need one more ingredient to make The Cake for the next person I can get to listen to me.
messages.zh: 我还差一样材料,就能给下一个肯听我说话的人做「那个蛋糕」了。

messages.raw: §fThis should do it! I've got some counting to do.
messages.text: This should do it! I've got some counting to do.
messages.zh: 这样应该就够了! 我还得算算账去。

messages.text: What cake? There is no cake.
messages.zh: 什么蛋糕?根本没有蛋糕。

messages.raw: §fMy mother told the doctor to not give me a name.
messages.text: My mother told the doctor to not give me a name.
messages.zh: 我妈当年跟医生说,别给我取名字。

messages.raw: §fBecause that's the best name - to not have name.
messages.text: Because that's the best name - to not have name.
messages.zh: 因为那才是最好的名字——压根没有名字。

messages.raw: §fThink about it, there is nothing to make fun of about your name if you don't even have one.
messages.text: Think about it, there is nothing to make fun of about your name if you don't even have one.
messages.zh: 你想想看,你要是连名字都没有,别人还能拿你的名字取笑什么呢。

messages.text: My mother is a genius!
Just like me!

messages.raw: §fI guess she got that from me.
messages.text: I guess she got that from me.
Actually that doesn't make any sense...
messages.zh: 话说回来,这好像根本说不通……

messages.raw: §fI mean of course it does, because I am a genius!
messages.text: I mean of course it does, because I am a genius!
messages.zh: 不对不对,当然说得通,因为我是个天才!

messages.raw: §fAnyway, aren't you getting tired of this?
messages.text: Anyway, aren't you getting tired of this?

messages.raw: §fTalking to a guy in a game?
messages.text: Talking to a guy in a game?
messages.zh: 在一个游戏里跟一个人说话?

messages.raw: §fInside a palace in a cave on a floating island?
messages.text: Inside a palace in a cave on a floating island?
messages.zh: 而且还是在一座浮空岛的山洞里的宫殿里?

messages.raw: §fIf you asked me, that makes no sense...
messages.text: If you asked me, that makes no sense...
How does that even work?
Anyway...

messages.raw: §fI think I am gonna get some rest soon.
messages.text: I think I am gonna get some rest soon.
messages.zh: 我想我该去休息一会儿了。

messages.text: It's getting kind of late.
I have a big day tomorrow.
Maybe you should go too?
I mean it's pretty dark outside.

messages.raw: §fIt's better you also go to sleep.
messages.text: It's better you also go to sleep.
Here, take this cake!

messages.raw: §fI know I said there is no cake.
messages.text: I know I said there is no cake.
messages.zh: 我知道我说过没有蛋糕。

messages.text: But the lie was a lie!
messages.zh: 但那句谎话本身也是谎话!

messages.text: I lied twice.
But you did it.

messages.raw: §fYou got what you wanted from me.
messages.text: You got what you wanted from me.
messages.zh: 你从我这儿拿到了你想要的东西。

messages.raw: §fEven though you probably just looked it up somewhere.
messages.text: Even though you probably just looked it up somewhere.
messages.zh: 虽说你八成是在哪儿查到的攻略。

messages.raw: §fAnd didn't even know about this beforehand.
messages.text: And didn't even know about this beforehand.
messages.zh: 自己事先根本不知道有这回事。

messages.raw: §fBut regardless, I hope you are happy now.
messages.text: But regardless, I hope you are happy now.
messages.zh: 但不管怎样,希望你现在开心了。

messages.text: Goodbye.
This is the end.
The end of our conversation.
It's over!
All of it is over...

messages.raw: §fYou can stop talking to me now.
messages.text: You can stop talking to me now.
messages.zh: 你现在可以不用再跟我说话了。

messages.raw: §fYou got exactly what you wanted from me.
messages.text: You got exactly what you wanted from me.
messages.zh: 你想从我这儿要的,一样不少全拿到了。

messages.text: And now it is over.

messages.raw: §fIf you wanna thank anyone, this is the time.
messages.text: If you wanna thank anyone, this is the time.
Because it's done - it's over.
messages.zh: 因为已经完事了——结束了。

messages.text: Seriously, it's over.
There is nothing else.

messages.raw: §fI'll start counting down, if you don't leave by then, I will be very angry...
messages.text: I'll start counting down, if you don't leave by then, I will be very angry...
messages.zh: 我开始倒数了,数完你还不走,我可要真生气了……

messages.text: Ok I'll start!
0 Time's over!
You are still here?!
Didn't I tell you to go?
I'll give you a second chance.

messages.raw: §fThis time I am gonna give you a lot more time.
messages.text: This time I am gonna give you a lot more time.
messages.zh: 这次我给你的时间会多得多。

messages.raw: §fI am gonna start counting down again!
messages.text: I am gonna start counting down again!
Wow, you did it!
You actually waited this long?
Man, you are very dedicated
You did this for hours??
messages.zh: 你干这个干了好几个小时??

messages.text: You waited all this time?

messages.raw: §fAnd no server restart made you disappear?
messages.text: And no server restart made you disappear?
messages.zh: 连房间重启都没把你弄消失?!

messages.text: I don't know what to say...
messages.zh: 我都不知道该说什么了……

messages.raw: §fI am sorry though, there is nothing here.
messages.text: I am sorry though, there is nothing here.
messages.zh: 不过很抱歉,这儿真的什么都没有。

messages.text: This is actually the end.
I swear!

messages.raw: §fNow you can finally go to sleep.
messages.text: Now you can finally go to sleep.
messages.zh: 现在你总算可以去睡觉了。

messages.text: My final goodbye!
messages.zh: 这是我最后一次跟你道别!

messages.text: Sweet dreams!
